Forecast Discussion

High pressure situated off the Mid-Atlantic coast will keep mild and pleasant weather around for Election Day. Moisture will be increasing quickly on southeasterly breezes, however, and clouds overspread the region tonight.

A frontal boundary inbound from the west will arrive on Thursday morning, inching slowly eastward through Friday. Rain will be increasing on Wednesday, tapering off to mostly morning showers on Thursday.

A follow-up upper level disturbance could produce a ripple on the front that will be lying just to our east on Friday. This might induce a passing light shower.

Thereafter, a dry and seasonably cooler air mass arrives for next weekend with abundant sunshine. Reinforcing cool air follows for the early part of next week.
